ranges.quote: The fancy name for this is chaos engineering. You go, "Okay, if I unalive this box, nobody should notice." And then you slime out the box and watch. If nothing happened, W rizz. If something did break, low-key also Ws because you found out at lunch instead of your two AM Diddy party. And then you get braver and start yeeting way more boxes at once, like a whole Ohio of boxes.
